documents.title: Returns and refunds
documents.text: Northstar Retail accepts unused products within 30 calendar days of delivery. Customers must provide an order ID and proof of purchase. Refunds go to the original payment method within 7 business days after the returned item passes inspection. Personalized items cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged. This is a fictional demonstration policy.

documents.title: Shipping and delivery
documents.text: Northstar Retail standard delivery takes 3 to 5 business days after dispatch. Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days after dispatch. Warehouse processing normally takes 1 business day before dispatch. Delivery estimates exclude public holidays. Tracking is available after the carrier scans the parcel. This is fictional sample documentation.

documents.title: Product warranty
documents.text: Northstar Retail provides a 12-month warranty for defects in materials or workmanship, starting on the delivery date. Normal wear, accidental damage and unauthorized repairs are excluded. Warranty requests require an order ID and a description of the defect. Approved claims receive a repair or replacement. These are fictional demonstration terms.

documents.title: Billing and invoices
documents.text: Northstar service subscriptions are billed on the first day of each month. Invoice payments are due within 15 calendar days of issue. A billing dispute should include the invoice number and the disputed line item. The billing team acknowledges disputes within 2 business days. This fictional document does not define tax rates or membership discounts.

documents.title: Customer support hours
documents.text: Northstar customer support is available Monday through Friday from 09:00 to 17:00 UTC. General support requests receive an initial response within 2 business days. Customers should include an order ID when asking about an order. The support team does not ask for account passwords. This is a fictional reference document.

documents.title: Severity-one incident response
documents.text: For a severity-one service incident, Northstar pages the on-call engineer within 5 minutes. The incident commander posts a status update every 15 minutes until mitigation. Engineers record the impact, mitigation steps and current owner in the incident timeline. Paging instructions apply to service incidents, not retail return requests. This is a fictional operations runbook.

documents.title: Incident review and follow-up
documents.text: Every Northstar severity-one incident requires a written review within 3 business days after resolution. The review includes a timeline, customer impact, contributing factors and follow-up actions with owners. The incident commander schedules a review meeting and tracks overdue actions in the operations backlog. This is fictional sample material.

documents.title: Reference data retention
documents.text: In this fictional Northstar service, billing records are retained for 24 months. Resolved support tickets are retained for 90 days. Operational event logs are retained for 30 days, after which only aggregate counters remain. Retention periods are demonstration settings rather than legal or regulatory advice. This document does not describe geographical hosting regions.
